verify_detail: m clear` (or otherwise resets app data) before every run, repeated CI executions will drift through the 5-cycle and fail on cold-starts #3 and #5 of every 5. Fix is either: (a) `pm clear`/reinstall before each test run so it\'s always launch #1 (counter=0, always visible), or (b) if the test is meant to only cover the "visible" case, assert conditionally on `launchCount % 5` (readable via the `SyncComponent init` debug log or an exposed diagnostics field) rather than assuming static visibility.'
